spans.text: M4, they've sealed us off!
What now?
Tsk, is there another route we can take...?
Not this way... This won't do either... What about this...? Dammit!
The enemies are closing in!
Backed yourself into a corner, have you?

The white units had M4A1 and ST AR-15 surrounded at a dead end in the building. A Nyto strolled out casually from among the units. She planted herself in front of the only exit and pointed her weapon at them.
...Didn't you say you couldn't control these Nytos?
I wasn't able to back then, but it was only a matter of time.
If you can occupy someone else's body, then why won't you just leave me alone?!
I was cultivated in your neural cloud in the first place, and I have no interest in controlling someone else's body.
I've been telling you all along that I am after the same thing as you – to find out who I really am.
It doesn't sound convincing at all coming from a puppet under your control.
What other choice do I have?
So what are you going to do? Shoot us full of holes?
Lunasia, do you know what your most valuable bargaining chip is?
Humph...
You know that I don't want to hurt you, but there is something I need to tell you.
The Doll in black lowered her weapon and pointed towards the distance.
Not too far from here, another company of the white forces are about to engage Ange and Griffin in battle.
What?!
If you want to stay here and dawdle, you'll have to kiss the last departing flight goodbye.
You still don't understand?
I only managed to hijack these units because the puppet who's in charge of them is busy elsewhere.
When it realizes what I'm doing, my hands will be completely tied.
Not only will you miss the last available flight, your chances of leaving this area alive will be practically nil.
I...don't believe you...
Yes, you do. You're just refusing to acknowledge that.
You're like a sulking child, being unnecessarily difficult and wasting precious time.
I am not—
You've already figured out the truth yourself.
The fact is that you can't do this on your own.
All I'm trying to do is to make you realize that and admit it yourself.
You...
So are you ready to take me back?
Of course, I can force my way through whether you're willing or not, but I'd much rather you ask me to come back in your own words.
Don't even think about it!
In return, I can freeze all these white units and this black puppet on the spot so that you can get to the signal tower right away.
You can only venture on if you survive. Don't just think about yourself. Consider what's best for the friend standing right next to you.
Well?
Do I even have a choice?
Of course you do. You've always had a choice.
30 minutes later.
The white units all stopped moving for some reason...
That's the best possible outcome.
This has something to do with you, right? Both the mysterious consciousness and the black puppet are...
Sorry... I'd rather not talk about that now...
Any news from Ange?
DEFY got back to us.
AK-12 sent us a set of coordinates. Their chopper will be waiting for us there.
But Ange is unconscious, and the Commander got captured by the white enemies... They went through a really tough fight.
...So the mission is still a failure in the end?
It's fortunate enough that we're all getting out of here at all... Just leave the rest till later.
Lunasia, this is just the beginning. We need an explanation. An answer. A resolution. The truth.
I know what I must do. You told me I've always had a choice, so I've made the choice to never believe you ever again.
That doesn't matter. I'll still help you because we are one. That's a fact that you can't deny or change.
One day, you will understand that everything is written in the stars, just as one day, you will finally accept the fact that you are Lunasia.
If that is true, then I will face it, and when the time comes...I'll even fulfill this destiny myself.
But your so-called "written in the stars" is just another pointless lie to me.
That's alright. Time will tell. When you stop being so close-minded, the answer will naturally present itself. Perhaps it simply isn't time yet.
But it doesn't matter. I don't mind waiting for the day when you finally accept the truth. I know such a day will come.
